Run config = the user's existing serving config for this model, unchanged except the bench-only fields (cwd, log, port, lib_dirs -> the CUDA 13.4 toolkit, vision.gpu off): --max-context 262144 --kv int8 --kv-resident 32768 --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5 --mtp mtp/rt --vision --vram-reserve-mib 700, --expert-profile data/expert-profile.bin, --expert-cache auto --prefill auto. No --pool-workers (engine default) and no --adapt-every/--adapt-swaps/--adapt-decay: that config predates the 2026-10-31 calibration, and the saved calibration is keyed on 63GB of RAM so it no longer matches this 127 GiB machine.
